rules.rule: An item is kept only if it would change a run on an unrelated input; task nouns are stripped or the item dropped
must: would it change a run\s+on an unrelated input
If nothing survives the strip, it is a Drop
When in doubt between Generalize and Drop, Drop
its standard's rule ids and sections, its modes, its tools — are\s+generic there

rules.rule: Pending skill edits pass the same gate as lessons; a dropped edit is reverted and flagged
must: Judge each lesson and each rule an edit adds by one test
For an edit,\s+Drop reverts the hunk
flagging each reverted\s+hunk

rules.rule: An item the skill already carries rewords that line instead of adding a second
must: Sharpen that\s+line instead of adding a second

rules.rule: An item that overrules the body or conflicts is held for the user; a held lesson stays in LESSONS.md
must: the item overrules the body, contradicts another item
a held lesson stays in `LESSONS\.md`
Narrowing\s+what the body or its standard permits is not overruling

rules.rule: Every kept item is validated; a failed check changes the verdict
must: a failed\s+check changes the verdict, never passes silently

rules.rule: A new probe must fail at the base and pass on the result
must: A new probe must FAIL\s+at the base
One that passes at the base proves nothing
Write its situation to withhold what the rule\s+makes a run go and read

rules.rule: Propose once for all skills and wait for the answer before changing anything
must: Wait for the answer,\s+then work unattended

rules.rule: Never cut a settled rule to make room; move condition-triggered prose to references
must: Never cut a settled\s+rule to make room
move condition-triggered prose

rules.rule: Each rule goes into the step it governs, never a loose notes list
must: put each rule into the step it governs
never a loose list of notes

rules.rule: A store under ~/.agent-data is folded only when the user names it
must: fold it\s+only when the user names it

rules.rule: Test the fold through craft:skill-eval run; a missing skill or tool is reported, not improvised
must: invoke `craft:skill-eval` through the Skill tool with\s+`run
never replace it with an improvised check

rules.rule: One fix per FAIL; second failure goes to the user; agent-run cases only on request
must: gets one fix and one re-run
Agent-run cases and blind rounds only on the user's request

rules.rule: An item that changes the description adds its requests to the trigger cases
must: an item that changes the description adds its requests to\s+`dev/eval/triggers\.json`

rules.rule: An undone Drop, Generalize, Reword, or Merge of a pending edit restores that hunk as the user wrote it
must: An undone Drop, Generalize, Reword, or Merge of a pending edit restores\s+that hunk as the user wrote it

rules.rule: Narrowing what the body permits passes the Consistent check
must: narrowing what the body permits is no conflict

rules.rule: The fallback store counts for obeying lessons; folding it still needs the user to name it
must: Obeying a fallback store's lessons is not folding them

rules.rule: A lesson restating a line of the same skill is Reword; Merge is for two items or a sibling's shared reference
must: a lesson restating a line of this skill is Reword

rules.rule: A lesson a sibling's shared reference already carries adds nothing to this skill
must: a lesson a sibling skill's shared reference already carries adds nothing\s+to this skill
